known_limitations: The report is read-only and does not change capability status, create governance, or create work packages.
Planned capability gaps are drawn only from explicit roadmap and registry evidence; no prose-only capability inference is promoted to implementation evidence.
Missing runtime Mission Control and validation metrics JSON artifacts are reported as missing-data states when only Markdown artifacts are available.
No ledger or devlog files were modified.
summary: Implemented a read-only Capability Gap Report that compares planned, implemented, validated, operational, degraded, dependency-blocked, future-candidate, observation, defect, and missing-data states from existing Estate artifacts without changing governance or lifecycle status.
